ruling.recommended_action: Close the dispute as not upheld; no fare adjustment or refund is due. Optionally send the rider a route/length explanation note.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider alleges a longer route, but the metered distance (8.81 km) is not longer than the quoted route (8.877 km) and the GPS trace follows the quoted polyline with no computed off-route segment; RD-1/RD-2 not satisfied.

Rain (18.5 mm) was present, but the route's speed bands are band 5 (free-flow) on PIE and Airport Boulevard, and no LTA incident supports a slow-traffic detour (RD-4); weather does not create refundable mileage.
Fare = metered base + distance + time + platform fee only, all published items (FARE-1); no toll/ERP, wait, edit-destination or cancellation fee added; FARE-2 not triggered.
